snippet.title: Marsupilami 2: Salsa Palombia | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Marsupilami 2: Salsa Palombia will be available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam & Epic Games Store on September 3, 2026. 

Preorder Now & Add to Your Wishlist Now:
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650170/Marsupilami_2__Salsa_Palombia/
- Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/marsupilami-2-salsa-palombia-93afbe
- PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017553
- Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/marsupilami-2-salsa-palombia/9n77cvtt1l9g 
- Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-games/Marsupilami-2-Salsa-Palombia-3108753.html

Play as 3 brave heroes with unique abilities in a turbo-charged 2.5D platformer 

A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake! The creature behind this crazy beat is none other than the Mummy Queen, back from the Land of the Dead with her minions to play a cursed concert with a calamitous crescendo. 

Journey through four vibrant worlds in this high-energy platformer, play the adventure with a friend in local co-op or on your own and help the Marsupilamis save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions!
